cases.skill_content: Before changing a database schema, inspect dependencies, use an expand-and-contract migration for live columns, and verify old and new application versions can coexist.

Compatibility tests pass against both application versions. The destructive cleanup is deferred until rollout completion.

cases.note: The skill directly prevented downtime and drove the safe implementation.

recommendation_pairs.skill_content: Prepare a concise release announcement from verified changes. Emphasize user-facing effects, include upgrade commands, and publish to the requested team chat after checking factual accuracy.

messages.content: Publish a short release update to the engineering chat with the upgrade commands.
I verified the changes, summarized the user-facing improvements, and posted the announcement.

messages.tool_outcome_notes: The announcement was delivered, but the command block rendered as one unreadable run-on line.

b_prescription.content: Those upgrade commands became an unreadable run-on line in the team-chat announcement. Update the release-announcement skill to require chat-native command formatting and inspection of the exact payload before sending.
